narrative.overview: The site is a telephone-exchange switchboard in gray-green enamel. Whole bands of the page are panel field; feature lines are rows of ringed sockets; a coral lamp lights only for the primary action, the line in view and things that need attention. Colour means state, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark enamel default; light enamel equally first-class
One accent (coral lamp), brass as the single secondary
Apple system type everywhere, sentence case, no web fonts
Flat surfaces, hairlines and tone; shadow only on device frames
Motion is lamp glow and one staggered rise

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Coral means lit, active or primary. It is never a decoration, heading colour or illustration fill.

rules.name: The Two-Enamel Rule
rules.body: Every new surface is specified in both dark and light using the same role tokens; never hardcode a hex outside tokens.css.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No all-caps and no letter-spaced labels; headings are sentence case in the system face.

rules.name: The Code Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only for code, commands and paths.

rules.name: The Lit Only Rule
rules.body: Glow is a state. A glowing element that is not active, hovered or primary is a bug.

dos: Do use --pc-* tokens for every colour and keep dark and light in step.
Do light a lamp only for the primary action, the active line or a state needing attention.
Do set ink on lamp fills and use lamp-text, not the fill, for coral text.
Do keep 2.75rem tap targets on buttons and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use real screenshots in device frames; theme scrollbars, selection and focus rings.
donts: Don't use a display web font, caps, or letter-spaced labels.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, gradient text, glass effects, or same-size icon-card grids as page structure.
Don't put coral on more than the lamp roles, or use a thick coloured side border on callouts.
Don't invent counts, testimonials or claims.
